feed.title: Business News - Markets reports and financial news from Sky

articles.title: Poundland insolvency: What went wrong and what next?
articles.summary: Poundland's collapse into administration was the outcome feared most by staff in the run-up to Christmas - and the government too.

articles.title: Huawei guilty of plotting to steal trade secrets and bank fraud
articles.summary: Chinese tech giant Huawei, has been found guilty of conspiracy to steal trade secrets and bank fraud after a landmark trial in the US.

articles.title: Anthropic plunges below IPO price in renewed tech sell-off
articles.summary: Anthropic shares have fallen sharply in a renewed tech-led sell-off, taking the stock well below its initial public offering (IPO) level of just last week.

articles.title: US investor Staple Street backs last-gasp German bid for Poundland
articles.summary: A US-based private equity investor is backing a last-gasp German offer to buy Poundland and save the discount retailer from a calamitous pre-Christmas collapse into administration.

articles.title: Football chiefs hold talks in bid to unblock New Deal impasse
articles.summary: The bosses of the Premier League, English Football League (EFL) and the game's watchdog are meeting on Tuesday in a fresh attempt to break the impasse over a landmark financial settlement.

articles.title: Former NatWest chief Rose to leave fintech FNZ
articles.summary: Dame Alison Rose, the former NatWest chief, is leaving the British-based fintech FNZ Group after just a year, amid a deep restructuring which will see close to a quarter of its workforce being cut.

articles.title: High street lender launches 'bank of mum and dad' mortgage - but there's a catch
articles.summary: HSBC has become the latest lender to launch a so-called bank of mum and dad mortgage.

articles.title: Four in five Black Friday deals are duds, research finds
articles.summary: Four in five Black Friday deals are duds, according to analysis of last year's sales.

articles.title: Nearly four million in destitution across UK, study suggests
articles.summary: The number of people in destitution across the UK is at a record level, according to new research, as approximately 3.8 million struggled to access basic necessities last year.

articles.title: Capita shares at 35-year low as firm counts cost of civil service pension failures
articles.summary: Capita shares plunged more than 70% on Monday after the UK-based outsourcer revealed plans for a cash call amid an expected slump in profits linked to its troubled Civil Service pension scheme contract.
